title: Property, Plant and Equipment—Compensation for the Impairment or Loss of Items
summary: Addressed accounting for compensation received for impairment or loss of PPE items, requiring treatment as separate events rather than netting. Withdrawn in 2009.

related.title: Property, Plant and Equipment
related.relationship: The parent standard whose 2009 amendment superseded SIC-14 by incorporating the 'separate events' principle directly into IAS 16
